title: A mouse model of Citrobacter rodentium oral infection and evaluation of innate and adaptive immune responses
protocol: Record the weight of mice one day before infection.
Fast the mice for 16 hours with water available ad libitum.
Orally gavage the mice with 5 × 10^6 CFU of C. rodentium in 200 μL PBS using a gavage needle (8#).
Insert the gavage needle parallel to the upper jaw until reaching the throat.
Verticalize the needle and insert along the esophagus without obstruction, until almost the whole needle is inserted.
Inject 200 μL of bacteria gently into the stomach with no liquid overflowing from the mouth.
Resume the diet after oral gavage.
Record the weight of mice daily for 21 days starting from day 0.
Analyze the weight change according to the initial weight recorded at day −1.
Observe and record stool consistency using scoring criteria (0: normal, 1: loose stool, 2: shapeless loose stool, 3: diarrhea, 4: diarrhea with bleeding).
Collect feces into sterile microcentrifuge tubes every other day for analysis.
Detect the ILC3s response at day 5 according to the protocol for “Assessment of the ILC3s response”.
Detect the adaptive T cell response at day 10 and the antibody response at day 21 following the protocol for “Assessment of the adaptive humoral immune response”.
Make a normalized fecal homogenate.
Weigh the feces using an analytical balance and transfer it to a sterile 5 ml tube.
Add 1 ml PBS buffer to every 50 mg feces.
Homogenize the samples thoroughly using a tissue grinder.
Count the CFU of C. rodentium in the feces.
Prepare a U-bottom 96-well plate, two multichannel pipettes, and PBS buffer.
Add 180 μl PBS to interlaced columns of the 96 well plate.
Add 20 μl of the sample to the first column.
Mix with pipettes and transfer 20 μl to the next column.
Dot 10 μL of each sample onto a MacConkey Agar plate using a multichannel pipette with interlaced tips.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 12-16 hours.
Count CFU of the last two countable dots on the plate.
Calculate the concentration of C. rodentium in the feces using the formula: C (CFU/g) = CFU in the dot × 2 × 10^(n+3), where n is the order of the dot counted.
Euthanize mice by cervical vertebra dislocation on day 5 post infection.
Isolate the colon from the euthanized mice.
Thoroughly remove gut content by scraping and slivering the colon.
Cut the colon tissues into 0.5 cm pieces.
Wash the tissues with 20 mL PBS to clean up remaining contents.
Transfer tissues to Wash Buffer I after initial washing.
Wash the tissues twice with 15 mL of Wash Buffer I at 37°C, shaking at 200 rpm for 20 minutes each time.
Wash the tissues once more with 15 mL of Wash Buffer II at 37°C, shaking at 200 rpm for 20 minutes.
Digest the tissues in 2.5 mL digestion buffer at 37°C, shaking at 150 rpm for 30 minutes.
Homogenize the digested tissues with a gentleMACS Dissociator for 1 minute.
Add 10 mL DMEM buffer to stop the digestion and create single cell suspension.
Apply samples to a 70 μm cell filter.
Centrifuge the filtered cells at 4°C, 650 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL DMEM buffer.
Mix with 1 mL of 80% Percoll solution to make 40% Percoll solution in a 5 mL tube.
Carefully layer 1 mL of 80% Percoll solution at the bottom of the suspension.
Centrifuge the samples at 4°C, 950 × g with no brake for 20 minutes.
Carefully remove the top layer of epithelial cells and upper 40% Percoll.
Collect the LPLs with the micropipette into a 5 mL tube.
Wash the cells with 4 mL FACS buffer by centrifuging at 4°C 650 × g for 5 min, twice.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells with 1 mL FACS buffer.
Mix 10 μL 0.4% Trypan Blue with 10 μL cells mixture.
Count the unstained cells (living cells) with the hemocytometer.
Resuspend 2 × 10^6 LPLs with 50 μL blocking buffer to block Fc receptor internalization.
Incubate the LPLs with antibody mixture 1 in 4°C for 30 min.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer.
Fix the cells with 100 μL fixation buffer at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 20 min.
Wash the cells with 200 μL permeabilization buffer at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 3 times.
Incubate the cells with Antibody Mixture 2 in room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 30 min.
Resuspend 2 × 10^6 LPLs with 200 μL 1640 medium with 10% FBS, 10 mM HEPES and 1 mM Penicillin-Streptomycin and incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Stimulate the cells with PMA (20 ng/mL) and Ionomycin (750 ng/mL) for 2 h.
Add BFA to the cells.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer.
Incubate the LPLs with Antibody Mixture 1 in 4°C for 30 min.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer.
Fix the cells with IC fixation buffer at 4°C for at least 12 h.
Wash the cells with permeabilization buffer at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 3 times.
Incubate the cells with Antibody Mixture 3 in room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 30 min.
Wash and then resuspend the cells with FACS buffer.
Detect ILCs by flow cytometry.
Define lymphocytes by gating CD45+ population.
Exclude dead cells by gating V780− cells.
Gate ILCs as CD3−CD90+CD127+ in the colon.
Define RORγt+ cells as ILC3s.
Euthanize mice by cervical dislocation at day 10 post infection.
Isolate mesentery lymph nodes (mLNs) from euthanized mice.
Grind mLNs to create a single cell suspension.
Resuspend 2 × 10^6 lymphocytes in blocking buffer.
Incubate lymphocytes with antibody mixture 4 for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells twice with FACS buffer at 4°C.
Incubate lymphocytes with biotin-labeled CXCR5 antibody for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells twice with FACS buffer at 4°C.
Resuspend the cells in FACS buffer.
Detect lymphocytes by flow cytometry.
Collect peripheral blood from mice at day 21 post infection using MiniCollect Capillary Blood Collection device.
Euthanize mice by cervical dislocation.
Store blood at 4°C for at least 12 hours.
Centrifuge stored blood at 4°C, 2500 × g for 30 minutes.
Collect the supernatant and centrifuge again at 4°C, 13000 × g for 5 minutes.
Collect the serum and store it at 4°C for immediate use or at -80°C for long-term storage.
Resuspend 1 × 10^8 C. rodentium in 100 μL PBS buffer containing proteinase inhibitor.
Dissociate C. rodentium by ultrasonication on ice three times, each time for one minute.
Add 300 μL B-PER Complete Bacterial Protein Extraction Reagent to the resuspended bacteria.
Mix gently with a vortex for 30 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Centrifuge the mixture at 4°C, 16000 × g for 20 minutes to remove cell debris.
Quantify total protein using BCA protein assay.
Coat C. rodentium antigens at a concentration of 5 μg/mL in 100 μL coating buffer on 96-well plates at 4°C for at least 16 hours.
Wash the plate with PBST buffer.
Incubate diluted serum on the coated plate as per kit instructions.
Detect IgG using HRP-labeled antibodies following the kit's instruction.
Develop the ELISA plate with ABTS substrate according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Read absorbance at 405 nm using an ELISA reader.
